keys.admin.search.title: Search All Banks
keys.admin.search.ph: Type at least 2 characters and press Enter or Search...
keys.admin.search.empty: Write something to search for questions
keys.admin.media.error_type_msg: Only images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP) and audio (MP3, WAV, OGG) are allowed
keys.admin.media.confirm_delete_msg: Do you want to delete this multimedia resource?
keys.admin.cover.label: Representative image (optional)
keys.admin.cover.help: JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP. Max 1 MB.
keys.admin.cover.error_type: Only JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP images are allowed
keys.admin.cover.error_size: The cover image cannot exceed 1 MB. Current size: {mb} MB
keys.admin.q.label: Question
keys.admin.q.media_drop: Drag a file here or click to select
keys.admin.q.wordsearch_intro: The words are hidden in a 10x10 grid in any direction: horizontal, vertical or diagonal, forwards or backwards.
keys.admin.q.wordsearch_words_label: Words to hide (2-6, 3 to 10 letters each)
keys.admin.q.wordsearch_help_grid: Each game generates a different grid with these words
keys.admin.q.wordsearch_help_play: Players see the list and mark each word by dragging or tapping its first and last letter
keys.admin.q.wordsearch_help_time: Allow enough time: 60-120 seconds depending on the number of words
keys.admin.q.type_fill_blanks: Fill in the blanks (Complete the sentence)
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_statement_note: The sentence is written below, with the words to guess in square brackets.
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_intro: Players see the sentence with blanks (one box per letter) and type the word for each one. The words to guess go in square brackets.
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_text_label: Sentence with the words to guess in square brackets (1-3 words, 4 to 14 letters)
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_placeholder: Infection with [Helicobacter] [pylori] causes over 90% of [duodenal] ulcers
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_normalize_note: Accents and lowercase are normalised automatically ([Époque] → EPOQUE). Ñ and Ç are kept.
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_help_play: Players type each word with the phone keyboard; the box count shows the word length
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_help_points: Scoring: 20 pts per correct word (or the random points) + one time bonus per question
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_help_hints: Hints: up to 3 letters per blank; the word is then worth 70%, 40% and 25%
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_help_streak: Counts as correct (and for the streak) with half of the blanks or more
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_help_team: In teams each blank is checked when completed and correct words appear for the whole team
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_err_no_blanks: Write at least one word in square brackets: [word]
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_err_too_many: At most 3 words in square brackets
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_err_unbalanced: There is an unclosed or stray bracket
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_err_chars: “{word}”: letters only, no spaces, digits, hyphens or symbols
keys.admin.q.fillblanks_err_marker: Do not write {{n}} in the sentence: the words to guess go in square brackets
keys.admin.q.survey_multiple_note: Each player ticks as many options as they like, or none. On reveal you see what share of those who answered chose each option, so the percentages can add up to more than 100%.
keys.admin.q.type_change_msg: Switching to “{type}” will delete the options and answers you have already written for this question.
keys.admin.q.option_image_add: Add an image to option {n} (max. 200 KB)
keys.admin.q.justification_placeholder: Shown when the answer is revealed
keys.admin.q.media_note_image: With an image, the presenter screen hides the options so the image is easy to see; players still see them on their phones.
keys.admin.q.media_note_audio: The audio plays on the presenter screen; it is muted on players’ phones.
keys.admin.q.mc_help_play: Players see checkboxes and can tick several options
keys.admin.q.mc_help_formula: Score = correct ticked × points − wrong ticked × penalty
keys.admin.q.mc_help_bonus: A perfect selection adds the bonus
keys.admin.q.mc_help_streak: Only perfect selections count towards the streak
keys.admin.q.mc_hint: Mark every correct one (1 to 6). Players can pick several.
keys.admin.q.num_mode_hybrid: Percentage with a cap (whichever is smaller)
keys.admin.q.num_value_units_help: Players within this distance of the answer score points
keys.admin.q.num_value_pct_help: Players within this percentage of the answer score points
keys.admin.q.num_cap_help: The margin never goes beyond this number. Empty: percentage only.
keys.admin.q.num_points_help: Awarded for an exact answer; the further off, the fewer
keys.admin.q.num_hint_placeholder: Shown to the presenter while waiting for answers
keys.admin.q.num_help_points: Points drop the further off they are, down to 0 outside the margin
keys.admin.q.num_help_exact: An exact answer adds 20 extra points
keys.admin.q.num_hint: A single numeric answer, no options.
keys.admin.q.word_help_statement: The question text is the definition of the word
keys.admin.q.word_help_letters: Players see 10 shuffled letters, including those of the word
keys.admin.q.word_help_play: They tap the letters in order to spell it
keys.admin.q.word_help_points: Scoring: 20 base pts + up to 20 time bonus pts
keys.admin.q.word_hint: Players see 10 shuffled letters and work out the hidden word.
keys.admin.q.quiz_hint: Write the options and mark the correct one.
keys.admin.q.survey_note: No correct answer: each player votes for one option and the reveal shows how the votes split.
keys.admin.q.order_hint: Write them from first to last; players will have to put them in order.
keys.admin.q.delete_msg: It will be removed from the bank when you save. Until then, “Discard changes” brings it back, undoing everything that has not been saved.
keys.admin.q.empty_title: This bank has no questions yet
keys.admin.q.empty_text: Choose the type, write the question and its answers. Everything else is optional.
keys.admin.q.err_word: The word must have 7 to 10 letters
keys.admin.q.mc_points_help: Added for each correct option the player ticks (1-100)
keys.admin.q.mc_penalty_help: Subtracted for each wrong option ticked (0-100)
keys.admin.q.mc_bonus_help: If every correct option and no wrong one is ticked (0-100)
keys.admin.matching.help_left: Left column: fixed, cannot be dragged
keys.admin.matching.help_right: Right column: players reorder it by dragging
keys.admin.matching.help_streak: Streak: all pairs adds to it, half or more keeps it, fewer resets it
keys.admin.matching.hint: Write each item next to its correct match; players will see the right column shuffled.
